words.example: Thanks for the heads-up about the surveyors arriving early.
words.exampleZh: 谢谢你事先提醒评审员会提早到。

words.example: We have the green light to recruit the weekend clerk.
words.exampleZh: 周末文员的招聘已经拿到放行批准。

words.example: An unsigned consent form is a red flag during any inspection.
words.exampleZh: 检查时，没签字的知情同意书就是一个警示信号。

words.example: Whether a meal break counts as overtime is still a gray area.
words.exampleZh: 用餐休息算不算加班，仍是一片模糊地带。

words.example: Follow the chain of command before you write to the director directly.
words.exampleZh: 直接给主任写信之前，先走汇报链条。

words.example: Least privilege means the kiosk account can print slips and nothing else.
words.exampleZh: 最小权限的意思是，自助终端账号只能打印凭条，别的都不行。

words.example: Privileged access to the blood bank is reviewed every Monday morning.
words.exampleZh: 血库系统的特权访问每个周一上午复核。

words.example: Session timeout cut the doctor off while she was still writing the note.
words.exampleZh: 医生还在写病程时，会话超时把她断开了。

words.example: Idle timeout is too short for radiologists who read long studies.
words.exampleZh: 对阅读长时间检查的放射医生来说，空闲超时太短了。

words.example: Account expiry dropped the visiting surgeon from the on-call roster.
words.exampleZh: 账号到期后，这位进修外科医生从值班名单里消失了。
